contract: Init creates epoch 0. A second init does not reset the partition.
An invalid batch list stores nothing. A write at the current epoch replaces the batches and advances the epoch. A stale epoch stores nothing.
Timeout turns an acquired span back to available, keeps its delivery count, and leaves the acknowledged span in place.
Reopen shows the same delivery count and acknowledgement. Delete stays deleted after reopen.
limits: Delivery states use persister values 0, 1, 2, and 4. The stale-generation code is Kafka FENCED_LEADER_EPOCH 74.
This is not the ReadShareGroupState, WriteShareGroupState, InitializeShareGroupState, or DeleteShareGroupState RPC.
The journal format is the local PLSHS001 snapshot.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
